text:
Priya (PM): kicking off a quick thread to close scope for Console Telemetry PRD. Main tradeoff is retention depth vs platform cost. Draft PRD: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example-prd

Sam (Eng): skimmed. Two red flags: dashboard query p95 needs an explicit SLO, and trace index cardinality could blow up for high-tenant volumes. Need NFRs and an ingestion backpressure strategy.

Devon (SRE): Agree with Sam. Proposal: default tenant retention = 30d; enable 90d/365d only for Dedicated/reserved customers. Also require reservoir sampling for any tenant > 10k traces/day.

Maria (Design): UX request: customers keep asking for transparent billing. We should add a per-tenant cost modal (per-route, ingest, storage). Mockup will show estimated delta before they confirm retention changes.

Lena (CS): Heads-up: NebulaHealth is asking for 13mo retention + scheduled S3 exports as a compliance term. They flagged this as contract-critical. If we don't support it hosted, they may ask for a dedicated instance.

Kevin (Infra): We can do per-tenant TTL via lifecycle policies + compaction. Effort estimate: 2 dev sprints + 1 SRE sprint for rollout and testing. Hosted cold-tier for >1y adds infra (cold storage, retrieval engine).

Priya (PM): Proposed MVP (Q2):
- Dashboards: realtime traces, top queries, error hotspots
- Traces: 1% default sample with session bump to 10% for error sessions
- Retention: default 30d; 90d/365d as paid tiers for Dedicated only
- Billing UI: tenant cost modal + per-route cost breakdown

Priya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (please refine):
```
1) Dashboard interactive queries p95 <= 300ms in canary cluster
2) Ingest pipeline sustains 500 rps with <1% drop at canary scale
3) Retention lifecycle job enforces TTL with test coverage
4) S3 export success rate >= 99% for 24h test runs
5) Cost modal displays monthly estimate within +/-10% accuracy
```

Sam (Eng): Add perf AC: compaction lag alert when >5m and an automated retry for failed exports. Also include a load test simulating a hot tenant with 50k traces/hr.

Devon (SRE): Add data-deletion AC: soft-delete must mark tenant data within 1h and final purge verifiable within 30d. Audit log for deletion actions required.

Maria (Design): UX AC: tenant settings must allow tier toggle and show cost delta inline. Long-retention changes require a confirmation modal and a short education blurb.

Lena (CS): If 13mo remains Dedicated-only, sales needs an exception workflow and contract language we can reuse. I'll draft that with legal.

Priya (PM): Decision proposal: ship MVP that gates >90d retention to Dedicated (Option A). Parallel spike: prototype cold-tier design for hosted offering later. Thoughts?

Sam (Eng): Vote A. Lower risk and faster to ship.

Kevin (Infra): A. If we do hosted cold-tier later, it's a big design and ops lift. Prototype is reasonable.

Devon (SRE): A, + we should run a spike for cold-tier to capture unknowns (restore perf, cost model).

Priya (PM): OK moving forward with Option A. Owners and next steps:
- Sam: finalize NFRs + perf test plan in PRD (owner)
- Kevin: open infra tickets for per-tenant TTL + compaction + estimate (owner)
- Maria: provide mockups for tenant settings + cost modal (owner)
- Lena: align with NebulaHealth and draft exception/contract language (owner)
- Devon: design soft-delete + purge pipeline + alerting playbook (owner)

ops-bot: PRD updated. Please add owners and link Figma. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example-prd

Priya (PM): Can we close decisions by EOD Friday so Eng can sprint-plan? If anyone has a blocker, say now :raised_hands:
